description: This file contains unit tests for the CheckAudioUnderflow task in the GStreamer-based media player, specifically testing the detection of audio underflow conditions.

classes.name: CheckAudioUnderflowTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the CheckAudioUnderflow task, setting up mock objects and context for each test.

methods.name: shouldNotTriggerAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Test case verifying that no audio underflow is triggered when the current position is behind the last sample timestamp.

methods.name: shouldTriggerAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Test case verifying that an audio underflow is triggered when the current position indicates a potential underflow condition.
